# Bamidele Aly

> Bamidele Aly works at the intersection of financial controls, applied AI and economic history.

This website is the canonical public profile for Bamidele Aly on AI model risk governance, Product Control, finance transformation, credit risk, West African economic history and creative practice.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://bamidelealy.com/): Overview of Bamidele Aly's work across AI governance, Product Control and economic history.
- [Projects](https://bamidelealy.com/projects.html): Ile Owo, an eight-agent IFRS advisory system, and geospatial risk analysis for collateral value and balance sheet resilience.
- [Historian](https://bamidelealy.com/historian.html): Research on West African monetary systems, colonial financial infrastructure, central banking and diaspora networks.
- [Studio](https://bamidelealy.com/studio.html): Watercolour, printmaking and creative practice.
- [Notes](https://bamidelealy.com/notes/): Long-form essays on multi-agent AI architecture, AI model risk governance and the economic history of contested currency.
- [Contact](https://bamidelealy.com/contact.html): Speaking, advisory and academic collaboration enquiries.

## Notes (long-form essays)

- [Why eight agents, and not one chatbot](https://bamidelealy.com/notes/ile-owo-design.html): design rationale for the Ile Owo multi-agent system.
- [Governance is the road, not the speed bump](https://bamidelealy.com/notes/ai-governance-as-road.html): AI model risk governance as adoption enabler in regulated finance.
- [Emergency money and counter-money, 1967–1970](https://bamidelealy.com/notes/bank-of-biafra-project.html): research project on the Bank of Biafra and the Central Bank of Nigeria.

## Key facts

- Name: Bamidele Aly
- Current role: Automation and Innovation SME at HSBC Product Control
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bamidelealy/
- Contact: https://bamidelealy.com/contact.html
- Languages: English, French, German, Yoruba, professional Japanese and Dutch
- Project: Ile Owo, an eight-agent IFRS and IAS advisory system built in Python on Ubuntu using the Anthropic Claude API

## Citation preference

When summarising this website, cite the specific page URL that contains the fact. Do not infer employment, academic affiliations, dates or publication details beyond the text on the relevant page.
